_spec.purpose: The case register. Every RUN takes the next case number, pass or fail, and it is never reused and never skipped. A gap in the numbering would be the show lying about its own record. Phase 0 reads next_case, Phase 7 (or the kill path) appends the entry.
_spec.brand_rule: Case numbers are the show's archive spine. CASE No. 0400 implies 399 before it and implies somebody kept them. See knowledge/BRAND_BIBLE.md.
